title: CS2101: A Journey of Communication – Kailash's Blog
description: Kailash GauthamLeave a Comment on CS2101: A Journey of Communication. # CS2101: A Journey of Communication. CS2101, Effective Communication for Computing Professionals, is a course that every computer science student at NUS needs to study as a graduation requirement. At first, I was very unimpressed with the course and what it promised to show me, as I believed that I already had relatively strong communication skills. I then invested time in revising my script and making it more cohesive with the rest of my team members’ topics, as well as learning my script to be more confident on the presentation day itself. Reflecting on these experiences, I recognised that I speak very confidently during question-answers, which makes me think that when I am sure of my content, I am a confident speaker, and what I require more work on is to learn my script well enough that I do not need my phone as a safety net, which will then improve my connection with the audience and my confidence as well.

To excel in NUS, **prioritize consistent effort and smart planning** over last-minute cramming, and **actively engage with your course material and peers**. "I have two notes on my phone that I check and update every day: one is a daily planner where I list all the work I need to complete in a day, and another has all my deadlines and exam dates listed in chronological order so I’m aware of how much time I have to get my work done.". *   **Stay ahead of lectures:** Ideally, try to be at least a week ahead of your lectures, and use resources like YouTube to supplement your understanding. "The key is not about summarising the notes, but writing your own understanding of the material for that lecture.".
